description: ClaimGuard run contract. Loaded and SHA-256 hashed before the first LLM token; the hash is written into the signed receipt.

verification.not_run_policy: a REQUIRED check that is NOT_RUN blocks the result (status blocked_unrun); it is never counted as a pass

receipt.key_source: CG_RECEIPT_KEY secret (Key Vault in Azure); ephemeral per-process key if unset

pricing.source: https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing (Standard tier, gpt-4o-mini); Azure global-standard list price is the same order - re-check before a paid deploy
pricing.note: list price estimate; the Vocareum course gateway may bill differently

human_signoff.effect: a draft whose machine checks all PASS is 'awaiting_human_signoff'; only a named human reviewer's approval in the UI or API makes it 'released', and the decision is added to a re-signed receipt. ClaimGuard never files or sends an appeal.

data_rules: public data only: CMS NCD/LCD, CA DMHC IMR, NY DFS external appeals
no synthetic claims, no invented patients, no PHI
precedents must be decided before the case year (no look-ahead) and never the case itself

never: remove or loosen a required check
